parameters.content:
## How Comfy-Org/ComfyUI got printed

6 appearances · 1 as the lead

Each row is one edition. Left to right: the signal the pipeline stored, the candidate pool it entered, where the desk placed it, what actually went to print. **Execute the workflow** to see each step’s record in its output panel.

## Provenance ledger

What the pipeline did and did not write down.

⚠️ **lead_slate** — 0 rows for this repo
No ranking, no rejection reasons. The desk’s judgment is unrecoverable.

✅ **edition_repos.headline** — 6/6 populated
The card text this repo ran under is preserved for every appearance.

✅ **edition_meta** — 6/6 populated
Model, call count and token spend recorded for every edition.

✅ **repo_snapshots coverage** — 6 of 6 predate the last appearance
Every stored snapshot falls inside the coverage window.

⚠️ **editor_picks** — 0 rows
No human or model ever second-guessed these calls on the record.

✅ **placement** — 6/6 populated
Section, slot and rank written at publish time — including quick hits, which were previously silent.
